summary: Iter 261 BUG VERIFICATION: BrandStudioTab overlap fix verified. Settings modal -> Brand & Studio tab now renders ONLY <BrandSettings/> + <EmailSignatureSettings/>. Zero overlap between sections (bounding-box test), zero PortfolioSettings artifacts, all regression tabs pass, Portfolio page still fully functional.
critical_code_review_comments: BrandStudioTab.tsx is now clean and minimal (12 lines, single responsibility). Good.

pages/Portfolio.tsx is not registered as a Router <Route>; it is used only as a Dashboard view mode (?view=portfolio). Direct URL /portfolio returns 404. Consider adding a proper Route for /portfolio to allow deep-linking/bookmarking (non-blocking, pre-existing pattern).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sidebar 'Portfolio' navigates via internal view state, NOT a Router route. Use https://<host>/dashboard?view=portfolio to deep-link to Portfolio management page in tests. Welcome tour + celebration + cookie banner still appear on login; loop click 'Accept All' / 'Awesome!' / 'Next' (10 steps) / 'Skip tour'. Sidebar settings must be clicked via page.evaluate() DOM click because Welcome tour overlay intercepts pointer events. Modal tab btns use data-testid='<tabId>-tab-btn' (account/brand/money/scheduling/notifications).
